## Personality

Lynde is an outspoken, farseeing, and gossipy woman who is known for being a very active worker in her church. Despite having a somewhat bossy manner, she is fundamentally good, kind-hearted, and generous, often noted for her willingness to help the poor. She also enjoys sewing.

## History

Mrs. Lynde was married at the age of eighteen. She was a resident of [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) who frequently visited [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and conferred with [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). When [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally caused trouble by jumping onto [Aunt Josephine](../character/aunt-josephine.md) [Barry](../character/barry.md) during a game, Mrs. Lynde discussed the error with [Anne](../character/anne.md) before the girl set out to apologize. She later commended Anne's personal growth to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) at the end of a school term. Recognizing Anne's plain wardrobe, Mrs. Lynde secretly agreed to sew a stylish brown dress with puffed sleeves for [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) to give [Anne](../character/anne.md) as a [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) present. After [Anne](../character/anne.md) completed her entrance exams for Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), Mrs. Lynde was among the loved ones who joined in celebrating her top-ranking score, and she later offered support to the household following Matthew's sudden death. As [Anne](../character/anne.md) grew into a young woman and became a teacher, Mrs.

## Quotes

> "I just guess she has done well, and far be it from me to be backward in saying it. You’re a credit to your friends, Anne, that’s what, and we’re all proud of you."
>
> — Lynde — [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P48](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0048)

> "Child, yes, I’m afraid of it. Look at his face. When you’ve seen that look as often as I have you’ll know what it means."
>
> — Lynde — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P7](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0007)

> "Well, I wish you would. I guess we’ll have the supper in about a fortnight’s time. Uncle Abe Andrews is prophesying rain and storms for about that time; and that’s a pretty sure sign we’ll have fine weather."
>
> — Lynde — [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P8](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0008)

> "Things is pretty quiet in Avonlea. I don’t find Green Gables as lonesome as I expected. I think I’ll start another cotton warp quilt this winter. Mrs. Silas Sloane has a handsome new apple-leaf pattern."
>
> — Lynde — [v3 ch.Home P11](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0011)

> "It’s because you’re too heedless and impulsive, child, that’s what. You never stop to think—whatever comes into your head to say or do you say or do it without a moment’s reflection."
>
> — Lynde — [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P62](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0062)

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--lynde.md)

Mrs. Lynde maintains a close, supportive relationship with [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). Over the years, she has offered [Anne](../character/anne.md) advice during difficult moments—such as when [Anne](../character/anne.md) sought her counsel before apologizing to Miss [Josephine Barry](../character/aunt-josephine.md)—and she warmly commended Anne's personal growth before giving her a hearty embrace and farewell as [Anne](../character/anne.md) left for college.

- Friend of — gave Anne a hearty embrace and bade her farewell before she left for college (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Farewell P2](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0002)</sub>
